items.title: South Africa's ANC records worst-ever results in local elections
items.summary: Voters cast their ballots at a polling station during South Africa's local government elections in Johannesburg South Africa's ANC has recorded its worst-ever showing in local elections since Nelson Mandela led the country out of apartheid and into democracy more than 30 years ago, a result the party has called "catastrophic" While it won the most votes of all parties in the country, the African National Congress won 30.76% of the overall vote, one third down from the 46% it gained in 2021, and a far cry from the 64.82% 20 years ago The story of its decline is also clear in the provinces and cities. The party won a majority in just one of the country's nine provinces, Limpopo. In 2021 it won six. It also won the most votes in just two of the eight cities, compared with six at the last local elections The Democratic Alliance (DA) came second in the overall vote with 24.64%, retaining majority control of the city of Cape Town.

items.title: Mozambique: Chigamane golf project breaks ground as Inhambane swings onto the global golf tourism stage
items.summary: The initiative was announced by the Presidency following a ceremony in Chigamane, a locality in the tourist district of Vilankulo, Inhambane province, where Mozambican President Daniel Chapo laid the foundation stone for the construction of the golf courses In a statement, the Presidency said the development represents an investment in diversifying Vilankulo’s tourism offer, seeking to strengthen the district’s ability to attract visitors and consolidate its position as a leading destination in national and international tourism markets The initiative aims to attract tourists from various regions of Mozambique and countries such as South Africa, Zimbabwe, Tanzania and Zambia, thereby laying the groundwork for local economic growth, business development and greater participation by national operators in the tourism value chain,” the statement said The Chigamane golf project forms part of the broader strategy adopted by the Government to develop golf tourism in Inhambane province.

items.title: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests
items.summary: Reza Zanganeh was one of the three men executed in Iran Iran has executed three men accused of carrying out armed unrest during January's anti-government protests, according to state media Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were accused of throwing Molotov cocktails and grenades, using bladed weapons and firearms, and setting fire to public facilities in the city of Karaj, west of Tehran, Iran's state news agency Tasnim , external reported The executions are the latest in a series linked to the protests, including those of people accused of having ties to Israel and the United States The number of executions in Iran has increased since US-Israeli strikes on the Islamic Republic began in late February The protest movement initially sparked in December last year by the high cost of living rapidly evolved into widespread anti-government demonstrations that peaked on 8 and 9 of January Iranian authorities reported more than 3,000 deaths, and blamed the violence on "terrorist acts" orchestrated by the US and Israel However foreign-based NGOs gave higher figures and the BBC…

items.title: EUMAM MOZ supports Lar Nossa Senhora dos Desamparados with essential supplies
items.summary: The initiative was attended by the EUMAM MOZ Force Commander, Brigadier General Sérgio Estrela, who, accompanied by Mission personnel, visited both the female and male residential wards of the care home. Beyond the delivery of the donated items, the visit provided opportunities for interaction and engagement with the residents in an atmosphere of fellowship and sharing, enabling Mission personnel to gain a better understanding of the realities and challenges faced by this community Photo: European Union Military Assistance Mission in Mozambique The Nossa Senhora dos Desamparados Care Home carries out valuable social assistance work that requires a continuous response to the needs of its residents.
